summary: The diff modifies backend/main.mo (Motoko actor) and several frontend files. The backend/main.mo file is truncated but shows data type definitions, state variables, and the beginning of actor logic consistent with implementing the required operations. Frontend hooks in useQueries.ts are confirmed to wire all mutation functions to real backend actor methods. However, due to truncation of backend/main.mo, full verification of all backend function implementations is limited. Frontend files were modified despite the constraint of 'No frontend UI changes', though the changes appear to be bug fixes/wiring rather than new UI features.

hallucinated_features.description: Frontend file modifications including UserView.tsx, useQueries.ts, and frontend-file-summaries.txt were changed despite the backend-only constraint.
hallucinated_features.reason: The build request explicitly states 'No frontend UI changes — backend Motoko code only', yet multiple frontend files were modified. While some changes appear to be wiring fixes, the constraint prohibits any frontend modifications.
